resources.string: "A gentle response when a task finishes while the app is open. Available on supported hardware."
"Changing server clears this device’s sign-in and local drafts. Server tasks and files remain."
"Use an HTTPS server address, such as https://lester.example."
"Sign-in did not finish. Please try again."
"Could not load the workspace. Check your connection and retry."
"The workspace needs to reload. Your saved drafts will be restored."
"Connect to your own Lester deployment. Tasks keep running on your server."
"Could not open the file picker. Please try again."
"Could not open a browser. Install or enable a browser and retry."
"Update Android System WebView or Chrome, then reopen Lester."
